🖥 International Maritime Organization commends Iranian ship for rescuing 73 People in Mediterranean Sea

📌 London, IRNA – At its latest meeting, the Council of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) deemed the Iranian vessel Negar and its crew worthy of special commendation for rescuing 73 people in the Mediterranean Sea.

In summarizing the decisions of its 137th session, the IMO Council endorsed the panel of judges' recommendation to grant special recognition to four commercial vessels nominated by the Islamic Republic of Iran, Kuwait, and Poland; the Iranian vessel "Negar" was included in this list of ships deemed worthy of commendation.
​
Negar upon receiving a message from the Cairo Rescue Coordination Center on July 7, 2025, the vessel altered its course in the Mediterranean and launched an operation to assist a distressed boat. After conducting a search and receiving updated coordinates, the ship located the boat and rescued all 73 people on board.
​
The report on the operation states that sea conditions at the time of the incident ranged from moderate to rough, with wind speeds of approximately 15 to 20 knots.
